Nanoswarms.Swarmtype.label: Digital Mind Nanoswarm
Nanoswarms.Swarmtype.description: A digital mind nanoswarm is a cloud-like swarm of nanoscale robots, remotely controlled by a digitized human mind housed inside a Neural Projection Cabinet. While these nanoswarm bodies do not have standard nutritional or sleep needs, they do have to return regularly to the projection cabinet to replenish the nanoswarms population.
Nanoswarms.Swarmtype.descriptionShort: A digital mind nanoswarm is a cloud-like swarm of nanoscale robots, remotely controlled by a digitized human mind housed inside a Neural Projection Cabinet.

Nanoswarms.Swarmtype.label: AI Nanoswarm
Nanoswarms.Swarmtype.description: AI Nanoswarms are cloud-like swarms of nanoscale robots, remotely controlled by an AI construct to grant the AI a physical presence. Frequently deployed to manage and maintain an estate, ship or even small governments.
Nanoswarms.Swarmtype.descriptionShort: AI Nanoswarms are cloud-like swarms of nanoscale robots, remotely controlled by an AI construct to grant the AI a physical presence.

Nanoswarms.Swarmtype.label: Subpersona Nanoswarm
Nanoswarms.Swarmtype.description: Subpersona Nanoswarms are cloud-like swarms of nanoscale robots, remotely controlled by an AI Subpersona construct to grant the AI a physical presence. These subpersonas are frequently created and deployed to serve niche roles in a company, estate, ship or government.
Nanoswarms.Swarmtype.descriptionShort: Subpersona Nanoswarms are cloud-like swarms of nanoscale robots, remotely controlled by an AI subpersona construct to grant the AI a physical presence.
